$schema: Example in examples/ for crawler.py --advisories (comma or space between clauses; e.g. >=1.0.0,<2.0.0).
_instructions: When creating NEW advisory files (e.g. via Cursor/AI), name them: advisories_<library>_<id>.json — library = short npm-related name (lowercase, underscores); id = CVE-2026-12345 or GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx if no CVE yet. Examples: advisories_axios_CVE-2026-25639.json, advisories_nextjs_GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3.json. Bundled templates use the .example.json suffix; drop .example for your own copies.
